resources.string: In Emdash on your computer, open Settings → Remote access and copy the link. Paste it here, or share it to this app. You only do this once per computer.
Not an Emdash link. It looks like http://address:port/connect?token=…
Check that Emdash is running on it and that this phone is on the same network (EasyTier, Tailscale, Wi-Fi). It keeps trying while this app is open.
Its link was replaced in Emdash. Copy the new link from Settings → Remote access and paste it here.
Remove %1$s from this phone? You\'ll need its link again to reconnect.
